prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need creative brand work, performance marketing (PPC/paid social), SEO, content, or enterprise digital transformation. I can help you find the best match. A quick plan below to find and evaluate the right partner.

Quick questions so I can recommend a shortlist
- What are your primary goals? (awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, SEO, creative/brand, product launches, etc.)
- Monthly budget or annual spend range for marketing/agency fees?
- Company stage and size (startup / growth / enterprise)?
- Industry or target markets (B2B tech, consumer, healthcare, fintech, etc.)?
- Any in‑house capabilities to keep or gaps to fill?
- Timeline (ongoing retainer vs short campaign/project)?

How to pick the “best” agency for you (checklist)
- Relevant experience: strong case studies and metrics in your vertical and objective
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence (CPL, CAC, ROAS, LTV, etc.)
- Team fit: senior involvement, named account lead, cultural fit
- Tools & tech: analytics, tag management, ad platforms, CRM integrations
- Transparency on pricing, deliverables, and expected outcomes
- References and clear contract terms (minimum term, exit clauses)
- Trial project or short pilot to validate performance

Where to look and shortlist sources
- Clutch.co, G2, and Agency Spotter for verified reviews and filters by location/industry
- LinkedIn to check staff, posts, and client announcements
- Case studies on agency sites and references from companies like yours
- Ask product/marketing peers in SF for referrals (meetups, Slack communities)

Typical agency fit by budget/need (rough)
- <$5k/month: freelancers or solo specialists (SEO, paid ads)
- $5k–$20k/month: boutique/specialist agencies (PPC, SEO, content)
- $20k+/month: full‑service growth/brand agencies or larger integrated shops
- Enterprise: digital consultancies (Accenture Interactive, Deloitte Digital) or large global agencies

Examples of types of agencies you’ll find in SF
- Large integrated creative/digital agencies (good for brand + product experience)
- Performance/growth marketing agencies (focused on measurable ad/CRM results)
- SEO/content specialists (organic traffic and content strategy)
- Paid social/PPC specialists (Facebook, Google, programmatic)
- Product/UX-focused agencies (conversion optimization, product marketing)

Next steps I can do for you
- If you share the quick questions above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 agencies in/near San Francisco tailored to your goals and budget (with what each is best at and why).
- Or I can walk you through an RFP template and evaluation rubric to vet agencies.

Which way would you like to proceed?
